title: Clipboard
description: Keep text, rich text, images and file paths available across apps
searchPlaceholder: Search content, source, date, tags, category or note
clearFilters: Clear category, tag and date filters
confirmSecret: This is sensitive content. Copy it to the system clipboard?
desktopRequired: This is a browser preview. Use the Friday desktop app for system clipboard history.
searchHint: Try another keyword or content type
emptyHint: Copy content in any app and it will appear here automatically
imageInvalid: Cannot decode image. Retry or copy it again.
imageMissing: Image file is missing. Copy it again.
imageTooLarge: Image is too large to preview or save.
imageUnavailable: Image was deleted, expired or is unavailable.
externalDeferred: System monitoring, tray popups, global shortcuts, automatic recording capture, screen pins and QR sharing are deferred to the next iteration. This release keeps the in-app clipboard and local data protection.
captureEnabledHint: Pausing stops new captures. Existing history remains available.
captureImagesHint: Save clipboard images to local history.
captureSensitiveHint: Encrypted, short lived storage. Turn off to skip new sensitive captures.
retentionHint: Automatic cleanup moves items to Recently Deleted; pinned items, favorites and phrases are kept.
sensitiveHint: Destroyed at expiry. Shortening also applies to existing sensitive records.
shortcutHint: Bring Friday forward and open the clipboard from other apps.
protectionHint: Sensitive content stays encrypted and masked, excluded from search and AI, and requires confirmation to copy. AI archiving is off by default. When enabled, non-sensitive text is sent to the selected model (charges may apply). Images use local OCR and sensitivity checks first. At most 30 automatic analyses per hour.
clearHint: Move ordinary history to Recently Deleted; keep pinned items, favorites and phrases.
clearConfirm: Move ordinary clipboard history to Recently Deleted? Pinned items, favorites and phrases will be kept.
shortcutUnavailable: Shortcut is in use by another app. Choose another combination.
settingsLoadFailed: Cannot load clipboard settings. Close and retry.
settingsSaveFailed: Could not save settings. Please retry.
capturePaused: Clipboard capture is paused. Resume it in Clipboard settings.
tagHint: Enter or choose a tag, then add it
sensitivePhraseBlocked: Sensitive content cannot be saved as a phrase.
organizeFailed: Could not save. Check names and content, then retry.
deleteGroupHint: Records remain available. Only the category or tag assignment is removed.
groupInvalid: Use a unique name of up to 40 characters without special characters.
aiEnabledHint: Only new captures are processed. Content meeting the threshold creates a note. Analyze history from its context menu.
aiTranscriptionHint: Untranscribed media is transcribed before archiving analysis. Processing is local by default. Selecting a cloud model sends media to that service; recognized sensitive text is blocked from the archiving model.
aiInstructionsHint: For example: study material, meeting highlights and work plans
aiFailed: Analysis failed. Retry from More actions.

aiErrors.CLIPBOARD_AI_SENSITIVE: Sensitive content detected; nothing sent to AI.
aiErrors.CLIPBOARD_AI_MODEL_REQUIRED: Configure a working chat model in Model settings, then select it here.
aiErrors.CLIPBOARD_AI_FILE_UNSUPPORTED: This file has no available parser. Its original path was kept; convert it and retry.
aiErrors.CLIPBOARD_AI_FILE_MISSING: The file is missing or could not be read. Check its path and retry.
aiErrors.CLIPBOARD_AI_MEDIA_TRANSCRIPT_REQUIRED: Transcribe the audio or video in its preview before asking AI to analyze it.
aiErrors.CLIPBOARD_AI_TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL_REQUIRE: The transcription model is unavailable or unsupported. Choose Windows local speech or configure a compatible transcription model. DeepSeek chat models cannot transcribe audio.
aiErrors.CLIPBOARD_AI_TRANSCRIPTION_ENGINE_UNAVAI: A local speech recognition language pack is missing. Install a Windows speech pack or select a transcription model in clipboard settings.
aiErrors.CLIPBOARD_AI_TRANSCRIPTION_TIMEOUT: Media transcription timed out. Split the recording into shorter clips and retry.
aiErrors.CLIPBOARD_AI_TRANSCRIPTION_INVALID_AUDIO: Windows could not decode or recognize this media. Convert it to PCM WAV or choose a compatible transcription model in clipboard settings.
aiErrors.CLIPBOARD_AI_TRANSCRIPTION_SERVICE_FAILE: The transcription service failed. Check its endpoint, credentials and network connection.
aiErrors.CLIPBOARD_AI_TRANSCRIPTION_INVALID_RESUL: Transcription returned no valid text or timestamps. Retry or choose another engine.
aiErrors.CLIPBOARD_AI_TRANSCRIPTION_FAILED: Media transcription failed. Check the source file and choose an available engine in clipboard settings before retrying.
aiErrors.CLIPBOARD_AI_MEDIA_TOO_LARGE: Media exceeds 25 MB. Split it into smaller clips before AI analysis.
aiErrors.CLIPBOARD_AI_OCR_FAILED: Local OCR failed. Check Windows OCR language packs.
aiErrors.CLIPBOARD_AI_NO_TEXT: No text recognized. You can save the image to a note directly.
aiErrors.CLIPBOARD_AI_TEXT_TOO_LONG: Content exceeds 24,000 characters. Analyze smaller sections.
aiErrors.CLIPBOARD_AI_BUDGET: Hourly limit of 30 automatic analyses reached. Retry later.
aiErrors.CLIPBOARD_AI_QUEUE_FULL: Analysis queue is full. Please retry later.
aiErrors.CLIPBOARD_AI_AUTH: Model authentication failed. Check Model settings.
aiErrors.CLIPBOARD_AI_RATE_LIMIT: Model rate limit reached. Retry later.
aiErrors.CLIPBOARD_AI_REQUEST_FAILED: Model request failed. Check Model settings and your connection.
aiErrors.CLIPBOARD_AI_INVALID_RESULT: Invalid model response. Retry or choose another model.
aiErrors.CLIPBOARD_NOTEBOOK_MISSING: Target notebook is missing. Choose another notebook.
aiErrors.CLIPBOARD_IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: Image is too large to save to a note.
aiErrors.CLIPBOARD_AI_CONTENT_CHANGED: The item changed during analysis. Check the item and analyze it again.

qrTextHint: Scan with another device to view and copy this content.
qrNetworkHint: Scan on the same local network to open the content page and download files.
qrShareUnavailable: The local sharing service is unavailable, so a QR code cannot be created for this image or file.
qrFailed: Could not generate the QR code. Please retry.
qrArchiving: Creating folder archives in the background…
qrLocalOnly: No LAN IPv4 address is available. Connect to the same network as the receiving device, then regenerate the code.
qrFolderZip: {count} folders were archived as ZIP files. Scan to download and extract them.
qrStopped: Sharing stopped. The previous QR code no longer works.
qrExpired: This share has expired. Generate a new QR code.
qrStopFailed: Could not stop sharing. Please retry.
appendLimitReached: This appended item has reached its capacity. Stop and restart append copying to create a new item.

qrErrors.FOLDER_TOO_LARGE: Folders exceed the combined limit of 256 MB or 20,000 entries. Split them, or create and copy a ZIP file to share.
qrErrors.FOLDER_TIMEOUT: Folder archiving timed out. Reduce the number of files, or create and copy a ZIP file to share.
qrErrors.LINK_UNSUPPORTED: A folder contains a symbolic link or junction and cannot be fully archived. Copy the actual files and try again.
qrErrors.FILE_MISSING: A source file or image is missing. Copy it again before sharing.
qrErrors.FILE_UNAVAILABLE: A source file cannot be read. Check permissions and whether it is in use, then retry.
qrErrors.SOURCE_CHANGED: Contents changed during archiving. Wait for saving to finish, then generate again.
qrErrors.TOO_MANY_FILES: A share supports up to 100 files or folders and 200 clipboard images. Split the content and try again.

memoHint: Add a note to this clipboard record. It saves when you leave the field.
appendHint: Append successive copies to one record; sensitive content stays separately encrypted.
appendActive: Append mode is on · {count} parts collected. Copy from any location, then choose Finish appending.
appendFailed: Could not change append mode. Check that capture is enabled.
secretUnavailable: This sensitive entry expired, was deleted, or cannot be decrypted.
assetUnavailable: The source file is unavailable. Check its location and retry.
mediaUnsupported: This media format or codec cannot be played here. Copy the file and open it in a system player.
codeEditHint: Saves the clipboard copy with indentation. Ctrl+Enter to save.
editFailed: Could not save. Your edits are preserved; check the content or retry.
memoFailed: Could not save the note. Your text is preserved; please retry.
linkFailed: Could not open the link. Check that it is a valid URL.
pinFailed: Could not open the pinned window. Please retry.
reorderHint: Drag to reorder; Alt+Up/Down to move
fileOpenFailed: Could not open the file. It may have moved, been deleted, or have no default app.
fileMissing: The original file or folder was moved, deleted or is unavailable.

imageToolHints.pen: Hold the mouse button to draw circles and lines on the image.
imageToolHints.textBox: Click the image to place a text box, then choose Add text.
imageToolHints.cropImage: Drag to select an area, then choose Apply crop.
imageToolHints.mosaic: Drag a rectangle to pixelate that area.

imageEditConflict: This image changed elsewhere. Close the editor and reopen it.
imageSaveFailed: Unable to save the image. Try again. The original is preserved.
imageEditTooLarge: Images up to 8 megapixels can be edited to limit memory use.
imageEditedCopy: Edits are saved as a clipboard copy. The original file is preserved.
captureRecordingsHint: While Friday is running, new videos in recording folders are collected after writes settle and the file is released.
recordingFolderHint: Add the save folder used by other recorders. Existing videos are not imported. Subfolders are scanned up to 3 levels deep. Pausing clipboard capture also pauses recording collection.
recordingFolderFailed: Unable to select a recording folder. Try again.
batchDeleteConfirm: Move {count} selected records to Recently Deleted? Source files will be kept.
batchOrganizeHint: Set a category and add tags to {count} selected records. Leave category blank to keep existing categories. Existing tags are kept.
batchSensitiveHint: Deselect private items before merging or organizing. Private content can be copied individually after confirmation.
mergeCopyHint: Create and copy a merged item in the current list order, keeping originals. The target app uses the clipboard formats it supports.
batchMerged: Merged and copied {count} items. Original records were kept.
batchFailed: The batch operation failed. Check that the records and source files still exist, then retry.

batchErrors.INVALID: This selection cannot be processed. Select the items again.
batchErrors.STALE: Some selected items were deleted or expired. Nothing was changed. Select again.
batchErrors.SENSITIVE: Private content cannot be merged or organized in batches. Deselect those items.
batchErrors.MERGE_LIMIT: Merge at least 2 items, with no more than 200 content parts in total.
batchErrors.TAG_LIMIT: Some items would exceed 20 tags. Nothing was changed. Add fewer tags and retry.

recordingCaptureFailed: Recording collection is unavailable. Check recording folders and access permissions in clipboard settings.

recordingErrors.CLIPBOARD_RECORDING_DIRECTORY_MISSING: A recording folder is missing or was moved. Choose its new location in clipboard settings.
recordingErrors.CLIPBOARD_RECORDING_DIRECTORY_UNAVAILABL: A recording folder cannot be read. Check its permissions or choose another folder in clipboard settings.
recordingErrors.CLIPBOARD_RECORDING_DIRECTORY_TOO_LARGE: The recording scan exceeded 8,000 entries; some contents remain unchecked. Choose a smaller recording folder in clipboard settings.
recordingErrors.CLIPBOARD_RECORDING_CAPTURE_FAILED: A recording could not be read or collected. Wait for saving to finish, check file permissions, or copy the video again.

phraseSaved: Phrase saved and shown in the phrases list.
externalImageHint: This image comes from a website or local file. Click to load it.
externalImageFailed: Image could not be loaded. Check the network or original file, then retry.
saveRichTextBeforeImage: Save or cancel text editing before editing this image.
pasteTargetHint: Switch to your target app, then press the clipboard shortcut. Paste sends Ctrl+V; the receiving app decides which content formats it accepts.
pasteFailed: Operation failed. Reopen the quick panel and try again.
queueArm: Allow shortcut paste for this queue
queueArmedHint: Paste only into the locked target app; stop when the app changes.
confirmExternalSecret: Paste private content into “{target}”? Confirm the app and current input location.
trayEnabledHint: Open the quick panel, view recent entries and control capture from the tray. Clicking a tray entry only copies it.
closeToTray: Keep running when the window closes
closeToTrayHint: Hide the main window only when the tray is available. Use Quit in the tray menu to exit completely.

desktopErrors.CLIPBOARD_PASTE_TARGET_MISSING: The target app is closed or not selected. Switch to it and reopen the panel.
desktopErrors.CLIPBOARD_PASTE_TARGET_CHANGED: The foreground app changed; paste stopped. Return to the original target or cancel the queue and choose another target.
desktopErrors.CLIPBOARD_PASTE_UNSUPPORTED: External paste is unavailable on this system. Copy the item and paste manually.
desktopErrors.CLIPBOARD_PASTE_FOCUS_FAILED: Cannot activate the target window. Switch to it manually, or copy and paste manually.
desktopErrors.CLIPBOARD_PASTE_INPUT_DENIED: The system rejected the paste keys. Check target app permissions, or copy and paste manually.
desktopErrors.CLIPBOARD_PASTE_MODIFIERS_HELD: Modifier keys are still held. Release Ctrl, Alt, Shift and Windows keys, then try again.
desktopErrors.CLIPBOARD_PASTE_CANCELLED: Paste cancelled; the queue position is retained.
desktopErrors.CLIPBOARD_QUEUE_STALE: This queue item was deleted or expired. Skip it or cancel the queue.
desktopErrors.CLIPBOARD_QUEUE_SENSITIVE: Private items cannot join a paste queue. Confirm and use them individually.
desktopErrors.CLIPBOARD_QUEUE_BUSY: Paste is in progress. Wait for it to finish.
desktopErrors.CLIPBOARD_QUEUE_PAUSED: The queue is paused. Resume it first.
desktopErrors.CLIPBOARD_QUEUE_EMPTY: The queue is complete or cancelled.
desktopErrors.CLIPBOARD_SHORTCUT_UNAVAILABLE: The shortcut is in use; shortcut paste was not enabled. You can still use the buttons.
desktopErrors.CLIPBOARD_IMAGE_MISSING: A source image or file is missing. Skip this item or copy it again.
desktopErrors.CLIPBOARD_PASTE_INPUT_PARTIAL: Only some paste keys were sent; the target may have received the content. Check the target before continuing to avoid duplicates.
